messages:
Cassie R: Postmortem follow-up: we're consolidating action items into a single runbook and attaching tests to prevent recurrence. Need owners for: adversarial promptset, nightly soak, chaos drill (kv-gc + worker eviction), and a short regression CI job.
Noah J: I'll take the adversarial promptset + regression CI job. Approach: pull incident logs, dedupe prompts, add 150 adversarial cases, and wire a nightly quick-run in CI (20m). ETA: PR by Thu.
Vikram S: I'll own the nightly soak + chaos drill. Nightly soak: 2h at 160 rps on staging with mid-run spike. Chaos: GPU eviction + kv-gc stall, in an isolated test pool. Requesting eng-platform help to ensure we have a throwaway cache.
Cassie R: Also need acceptance definitions. Proposed: regression = no >1% drop on top-line accuracy; tokenization edge = <0.4% new tokenization errors; soak = p95 <220ms and no >0.3% retries; chaos = only transient slowdowns and successful recovery within 15m.
sre-bot: Filed SRE-3210 "Post-incident: tests + runbook" and assigned Cassie R, Noah J, Vikram S. Link: https://redwood.internal/SRE-3210
Noah J: We'll also include a small deterministic replay harness so seeding the exact request timeline is possible locally.
Vikram S: Scheduling ask: can we run the chaos exercise Sat 01:00 PST when staging traffic is quiet? Need SRE to be oncall.
ops-bot: Linked SRE-3210 to infra and scheduled Sat 01:00 PST window with eng-sre oncall.
Cassie R: Good. Also let's add a short retrospective doc after the first successful run to capture learnings and any gaps in acceptance criteria. I'll draft it.
Noah J: Adding a quick CI snippet to include the adversarial bucket in nightly checks:
```
- name: adversarial-smoke
  run: ./evals/run --bucket=incident_adversarial --duration=20m --thresholds-file=thresholds.json
```
Vikram S: For rollback steps during chaos: abort-gc, snapshot-restore, and restart-workers in sequence. I'll paste exact commands in SRE-3210.
Cassie R: Owners recap: Noah (prompts + CI) PR Thu, Vikram (soak + chaos + rollback) Sat chaos window, Cassie (runbook + retrospective). We'll aim to have the customer blurb ready the day after the run.
Noah J: I'll also add a small note about decoding-config parity with prod: run with prod sampling and a single variant (top-p 0.9) to surface sampling-sensitive issues.
Cassie R: Thanks everyone. I'll update SRE-3210 now and post any adjustments here. :white_check_mark:
